questions.stem: Why does an athlete require more carbohydrates in their diet than a person with a sedentary job?

options.text: Athletes need more vitamins to stay healthy
Athletes use more energy during exercise, so they need more carbohydrates as fuel
Athletes need carbohydrates to build larger muscles
Carbohydrates help athletes recover from injuries faster

questions.explanation: Athletes have higher energy demands due to physical activity. Carbohydrates are the body's primary energy source for respiration during exercise.
